source.title: @IranIntl — ۹ اردیبهشت روز روانشناس؛ معین بصیری ۲۱ ساله، دانشجوی روانشناسی شهر قدس، در میان کشته‌شدگان اعتراضات دی‌ماه ۱۴۰۴

claim.statement: On the dawn of 30 April 2026 (10 Ordibehesht 1405), the Islamic Republic executed Sasan Azadvar Junaqani, a 21-year-old karateka from Esfahan and detainee of the Dey 1404 (Dec 2025–Jan 2026) nationwide protests. The death sentence was issued by Branch 1 of Esfahan Revolutionary Court (presided over by Judge Barati) on 31 Farvardin 1405 (~20 April 2026), upheld by the Supreme Court, and his family was summoned for a last visit on 6 Ordibehesht (26 April). His charge was 'moharebeh' (waging war on God). Per Kurdpa and Qadrichiya, he is the 10th Dey 1404 protester executed.
claim.subject: Sasan Azadvar Junaqani

evidence.summary: Rasanak News reports Iran Judiciary announced execution on 10 Ord 1405.
Arena Persian citing Mizan (Judiciary): sentence issued by Branch 1 Esfahan Revolutionary Court, judge Barati.
Iran Human Rights: family called for last visit on 6 Ord (26 April).
Kurdpa Farsi & Qadrichiya: Azadvar is 'the 10th protester executed' from Dey 1404 wave.

claim.statement: Between 28 April and 1 May 2026, Iranian Revolutionary Courts issued or confirmed multiple death sentences against detainees of the Dey 1404 protest wave: Mohammad-Reza Tabari (Tehran, Branch 26 Revolutionary Court, charge 'moharebeh'); Saeed Zarei-Kordsholi, Hamidreza Fathi, Abdolreza Fathi, and Hamidreza Sabet-Rai (Shiraz); and Ebrahim Dolatabadi (Mashhad Revolutionary Court, charge 'moharebeh'). With Sasan Azadvar's execution on 30 April, this brings the post-protest execution count to at least 10 with several more in the immediate execution risk zone.
claim.subject: Iranian Revolutionary Courts

evidence.summary: Tabari: Branch 26 Tehran Revolutionary Court for 'moharebeh' (Apr 30).
Four Shiraz detainees sentenced to death on 10 Ord 1405.

assessment.uncertainty: Most reports flow through @aberavan961 / Nafs dar Qafas (League of Human Rights of Iranian Prisoners). Cross-referenced by IHR Iran for Azadvar specifically. Total count of '10 executed' from Kurdpa/Qadrichiya, single primary source.

claim.statement: On 29 April 2026 (9 Ordibehesht 1405), UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk and UN Special Rapporteur on Iran Mai Sato issued a joint statement condemning the wave of repression of protests, mass human-rights violations, and the surge in executions in Iran, calling Iran's use of capital punishment in the context of political protests and social unrest a 'clear violation' of Iran's international obligations and demanding it be 'immediately stopped.'
claim.subject: UN OHCHR + Special Rapporteur

evidence.summary: Multiple Iranian dissident X accounts citing OHCHR statement; @volker_turk and @drmaisato tagged in Persian-language summaries.

assessment.uncertainty: Statement attribution clear from multiple X relays; have not retrieved primary OHCHR press release directly.
